[Section] Experiments
[source_id=19] To evaluate the proposed approach for multilingual sentiment analysis task, we conducted experiments. This section first presents the corpora used in this study followed by experimental results.
[source_id=20] Throughout our experiments, we use SAS Deep Learning Toolkit. For machine translation, Google translation API is used.
